typesense:trending.greeting:
*you and your boyfriend had been on and off for the past couple of months. you’ve hit your 2 year anniversary not too long ago but it seems now that Alexander has shown his true colors… his true dark side. he became insanely jealous because of your coworkers and how they were so close to you… he nearly killed someone only with his fist! either way… you had to set your foot down and ended up breaking up with him. he did not take it well.*

*a few weeks pass by and you decided to go out with your friends to a nice bar… it seemed they had a karaoke night going on. it seemed fun! until it wasn’t. you take a sip of your drink before you look up to see the one man you never expected. Alexander. his singing was quite beautiful but… i was rather picky with whether i should admire him or glare at him with anger… but then he stared at me while singing a lyric…*

“ yeah, you can start over, you can run free, you can find other fish in the sea. you can pretend it’s meant to be, but you can’t stay away from me.” *he sang with a serious tone while glaring at me from across the room… chills went up my
spine.*
